S2_missed_recurrences_WG2: Genuine WGII recurrences hidden by mis-splits; add k to WGII numerator. This is a BREAK-EVEN arithmetic quantity, not an estimate of the true identity-error rate.

S3_duplicate_earlier_WG3: Mis-split non-recurring earlier identities added to WGIII denominator; add k to WGIII denominator. This is a BREAK-EVEN arithmetic quantity, not an estimate of the true identity-error rate.

S4_duplicate_earlier_WG2: Merged duplicate earlier identities removed from WGII denominator; subtract k from WGII denominator. This is a BREAK-EVEN arithmetic quantity, not an estimate of the true identity-error rate.

S5_symmetric_false_recurrences: Same number k of false shared identities in BOTH groups; subtract k from each numerator. This is a BREAK-EVEN arithmetic quantity, not an estimate of the true identity-error rate.
